Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : patna ke bihta se anant sinh ke hone vale damad rishikesh barat lekar nikal gae hain. jis diphendar ko anant sinh ne tilak ke din diya tha usi par charhkar rishikesh apni dulhan ko lane ke lie nikle hain. bihta se mokama ke nadvan jane men karib do ghante lag sakte hain. jam ki sthiti rahi to aur bhi vakt lag sakta hai. nadvan men mahajam laga hai. din se hi log pahunchne lage the. khana bhi din men hi shuru ho gaya tha.
